units.source_text: 源氏公子仅用几个不甚触目的家臣为前驱。

en.t: Prince Genji used only a few inconspicuous retainers as his outriders.

units.source_text: 对左右说：“我到了这年纪，除了宫中以外，竟懒得走动了。

en.t: He said to those beside him, "At my age, apart from the palace, I have grown quite reluctant to go anywhere.

units.source_text: 只是桃园邸内的五公主，近来境遇孤寂。

en.t: But the Fifth Princess at the Momozono residence has lately been living in lonely circumstances.

units.source_text: 式部卿亲王在世之时，曾经托我照顾她。

en.t: When Prince Shikibukyo was still alive, he once entrusted her care to me.

units.source_text: 现在她自己也曾请求我。

en.t: Now she herself has also appealed to me.

units.source_text: 左右之人私下诽议：“天哪！

en.t: The people around him whispered criticism in private: "Good heavens!

units.source_text: 他那多情多爱的老毛病始终难改呢。

en.t: That old habit of his, being so amorous and full of attachments, is hard to change after all.
It is truly a flaw in an otherwise perfect jewel!
Let us hope he does not cause trouble!"
